scenes.zh: 自然博物馆快开新展览了。小穿山甲岩岩接到任务：让大家看懂，平时很稳的地面为什么有时会摇？
scenes.en: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: explain why the ground, usually so steady, sometimes shakes.

zh.sourceText: 自然博物馆快开新展览了。小穿山甲岩岩接到任务：让大家看懂，平时很稳的地面为什么有时会摇？

en.sourceText: A new exhibition was opening at the natural history museum. Yan-Yan the little pangolin had a job: explain why the ground, usually so steady, sometimes shakes.

scenes.zh: 岩岩把两块岩石模型摆好。它们纹丝不动。他问：“大地也要有人推吗？”
scenes.en: Yan-Yan set two model rock blocks in place. They stayed still. He asked, “Does someone have to push the Earth too?”

zh.sourceText: 岩岩把两块岩石模型摆好。它们纹丝不动。他问：
“大地也要有人推吗？”

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan set two model rock blocks in place. They stayed still. He asked,
“Does someone have to push the Earth too?”

scenes.zh: 讲解员带他看大地的地图。地球坚硬的外层分成许多板块，平时也在很慢地移动。它们的运动会让岩石受到挤压、拉伸或错开的作用。今天，岩岩先看向内挤压的一种情形。
scenes.en: The guide showed him a map of Earth. Its hard outer shell is divided into plates that move very slowly, even on a quiet day. Their motion can squeeze, stretch, or shear rock. Today, Yan-Yan would watch one case of squeezing.

zh.sourceText: 讲解员带他看大地的地图。地球坚硬的外层分成许多板块，平时也在很慢地移动。它们的运动会让岩石受到挤压、拉伸或错开的作用。今天，岩岩先看向内挤压的一种情形。

en.sourceText: The guide showed him a map of Earth. Its hard outer shell is divided into plates that move very slowly, even on a quiet day. Their motion can squeeze, stretch, or shear rock. Today, Yan-Yan would watch one case of squeezing.

scenes.zh: 岩岩轻轻推动模型。岩石里原有的接缝叫断层。两边被压在一起，摩擦阻住了滑动；外面的作用还在继续，周围岩石却已经发生了很小的弹性形变。放大看，原本直直的纹路弯了。
scenes.en: Yan-Yan pushed gently. A fault is a break in rock along which its sides can slip. Here the sides were pressed together, and friction resisted sliding. The loading continued, so the surrounding rock deformed a little elastically. In the enlarged view, straight markings bent.

zh.sourceText: 岩岩轻轻推动模型。岩石里原有的接缝叫断层。两边被压在一起，摩擦阻住了滑动；外面的作用还在继续，周围岩石却已经发生了很小的弹性形变。放大看，原本直直的纹路弯了。

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan pushed gently. A fault is a break in rock along which its sides can slip. Here the sides were pressed together, and friction resisted sliding. The loading continued, so the surrounding rock deformed a little elastically. In the enlarged view, straight markings bent.

scenes.zh: 岩岩盯着纹路：“接缝没滑，推过去的能量去哪了？”一部分能量储存在变形的岩石里，就像弹簧被压缩后能弹回来。岩石不是软软的弹簧，但也能发生很小的弹性形变。
scenes.en: Yan-Yan watched the markings. “If the fault has not slipped, where did the energy go?” Some energy was stored in the deformed rock, just as a compressed spring stores energy. Rock is not a soft spring, but it can deform elastically by a small amount.

zh.sourceText: 岩岩盯着纹路：
“接缝没滑，推过去的能量去哪了？”
一部分能量储存在变形的岩石里，就像弹簧被压缩后能弹回来。岩石不是软软的弹簧，但也能发生很小的弹性形变。

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan watched the markings.
“If the fault has not slipped, where did the energy go?”
Some energy was stored in the deformed rock, just as a compressed spring stores energy. Rock is not a soft spring, but it can deform elastically by a small amount.

scenes.zh: 继续加载，岩石沿断层滑动的趋势终于超过了这里的阻力，接缝突然滑了！周围岩石部分回弹，弯曲减小了。两边却已换了位置：纹路仍然错开，没有回到最初的样子。
scenes.en: As loading continued, the tendency to slip overcame the resistance here. The fault slipped suddenly! The surrounding rock rebounded partly, and its bending decreased. But the sides were now in new positions. The markings stayed offset instead of returning to the beginning.

zh.sourceText: 继续加载，岩石沿断层滑动的趋势终于超过了这里的阻力，接缝突然滑了！周围岩石部分回弹，弯曲减小了。两边却已换了位置：纹路仍然错开，没有回到最初的样子。

en.sourceText: As loading continued, the tendency to slip overcame the resistance here. The fault slipped suddenly! The surrounding rock rebounded partly, and its bending decreased. But the sides were now in new positions. The markings stayed offset instead of returning to the beginning.

scenes.zh: 岩岩问：“那储存的能量呢？”一部分随着地震波向外传开，一部分变成了摩擦产生的热等。慢慢积累的能量，能在很短的时间里释放。
scenes.en: Yan-Yan asked, “What happened to the stored energy?” Some spread outward in seismic waves. Some became heat from friction and other changes. Energy that accumulated slowly could be released in a short time.

zh.sourceText: 岩岩问：
“那储存的能量呢？”
一部分随着地震波向外传开，一部分变成了摩擦产生的热等。慢慢积累的能量，能在很短的时间里释放。

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan asked,
“What happened to the stored energy?”
Some spread outward in seismic waves. Some became heat from friction and other changes. Energy that accumulated slowly could be released in a short time.

scenes.zh: 岩岩在地下和地表各选了一个小标记，又留下近、远两面感应旗。他望着它们，等着看同一次振动怎样从地下传到地面。
scenes.en: Yan-Yan chose one marker underground and another at the surface, and left a near and a far signal flag. He watched them to see how one disturbance traveled from underground toward the surface.

zh.sourceText: 岩岩在地下和地表各选了一个小标记，又留下近、远两面感应旗。他望着它们，等着看同一次振动怎样从地下传到地面。

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan chose one marker underground and another at the surface, and left a near and a far signal flag. He watched them to see how one disturbance traveled from underground toward the surface.

scenes.zh: 波传过去时，地下的小标记在原位附近来回动。岩岩发现：“它没有一路跑到地面！传开的是振动和能量。”
scenes.en: As the wave passed, the underground marker moved back and forth near its starting place. Yan-Yan noticed, “It did not run all the way to the surface! The vibration and energy are spreading.”

zh.sourceText: 波传过去时，地下的小标记在原位附近来回动。岩岩发现：
“它没有一路跑到地面！传开的是振动和能量。”

en.sourceText: As the wave passed, the underground marker moved back and forth near its starting place. Yan-Yan noticed,
“It did not run all the way to the surface! The vibration and energy are spreading.”

scenes.zh: 振动到达地表，地表的小标记也在原位附近动起来。这就是波引起的地面振动。断层滑动留下的错位，与波经过时的来回振动，是两种不同的变化。
scenes.en: When the disturbance reached the surface, the surface marker also moved near its starting place. This was ground motion caused by the wave. The offset left by fault slip and the back-and-forth motion as a wave passes are two different changes.

zh.sourceText: 振动到达地表，地表的小标记也在原位附近动起来。这就是波引起的地面振动。断层滑动留下的错位，与波经过时的来回振动，是两种不同的变化。

en.sourceText: When the disturbance reached the surface, the surface marker also moved near its starting place. This was ground motion caused by the wave. The offset left by fault slip and the back-and-forth motion as a wave passes are two different changes.

scenes.zh: 岩岩把展览摆好了：持续作用让岩石变形并储能；断层突然滑动，周围岩石部分回弹；一部分能量随地震波传开，让经过的地方振动。每幅展图都连着一个“为什么”。
scenes.en: Yan-Yan finished the display. Continued loading deformed rock and stored energy. Sudden fault slip allowed surrounding rock to rebound partly. Some energy spread in seismic waves, making the places they passed vibrate. Each exhibit answered a “why.”

zh.sourceText: 岩岩把展览摆好了：持续作用让岩石变形并储能；断层突然滑动，周围岩石部分回弹；一部分能量随地震波传开，让经过的地方振动。每幅展图都连着一个“为什么”。

en.sourceText: Yan-Yan finished the display. Continued loading deformed rock and stored energy. Sudden fault slip allowed surrounding rock to rebound partly. Some energy spread in seismic waves, making the places they passed vibrate. Each exhibit answered a “why.”

scenes.zh: 小伙伴们来了。岩岩指着纹路、断层和两个小标记：“先看慢慢积累，再看突然释放。地面摇，是振动传到了这里！”
scenes.en: The visitors arrived. Yan-Yan pointed to the markings, the fault, and the two markers. “First watch energy build slowly, then release suddenly. The ground shakes when the vibration reaches here!”

zh.sourceText: 小伙伴们来了。岩岩指着纹路、断层和两个小标记：
“先看慢慢积累，再看突然释放。地面摇，是振动传到了这里！”

en.sourceText: The visitors arrived. Yan-Yan pointed to the markings, the fault, and the two markers.
“First watch energy build slowly, then release suddenly. The ground shakes when the vibration reaches here!”

scenes.zh: 板块不是等到地震才动。地球内部的热与重力等作用参与驱动板块缓慢运动。运动的板块可以把作用传到远处的岩石；一小段断层暂时锁住，并不意味着整个板块和周围岩石都停止变化。
scenes.en: Plates do not wait for an earthquake to move. Processes involving Earth’s internal heat and gravity help drive their slow motion. Moving plates can load rock farther away. A locally locked part of a fault does not mean that a whole plate and all nearby rock have stopped changing.

zh.sourceText: 板块不是等到地震才动。地球内部的热与重力等作用参与驱动板块缓慢运动。运动的板块可以把作用传到远处的岩石；一小段断层暂时锁住，并不意味着整个板块和周围岩石都停止变化。

en.sourceText: Plates do not wait for an earthquake to move. Processes involving Earth’s internal heat and gravity help drive their slow motion. Moving plates can load rock farther away. A locally locked part of a fault does not mean that a whole plate and all nearby rock have stopped changing.

scenes.zh: 断层两边的岩石相互接触。被压在一起的接触部位会抵抗滑动，这种阻力与摩擦有关。周围仍受作用时，岩石中的微小弹性形变可以储存能量。它并不需要先出现一条肉眼可见的大弯。
scenes.en: Rock on the two sides of a fault is in contact. Contact areas pressed together resist sliding through friction. While the surrounding rock remains loaded, tiny elastic deformation can store energy. No large, visible bend is needed.

zh.sourceText: 断层两边的岩石相互接触。被压在一起的接触部位会抵抗滑动，这种阻力与摩擦有关。周围仍受作用时，岩石中的微小弹性形变可以储存能量。它并不需要先出现一条肉眼可见的大弯。

en.sourceText: Rock on the two sides of a fault is in contact. Contact areas pressed together resist sliding through friction. While the surrounding rock remains loaded, tiny elastic deformation can store energy. No large, visible bend is needed.

scenes.zh: 在这种锁定后突然滑动的情形中，滑动开始后，阻力可能降低，使滑动很快发展。岩石的弹性形变减小，储存的部分能量释放；滑动停止后，两边仍可有永久错位，也可能仍有未释放的作用。另一些断层可以缓慢滑动，并不是每次板块移动都会发生地震。
scenes.en: In this kind of sudden slip after locking, resistance can decrease once sliding starts, allowing slip to develop rapidly. Elastic deformation decreases and some stored energy is released. After motion stops, permanent offset and some remaining loading can persist. Other faults can creep slowly; not every movement of a plate produces an earthquake.

zh.sourceText: 在这种锁定后突然滑动的情形中，滑动开始后，阻力可能降低，使滑动很快发展。岩石的弹性形变减小，储存的部分能量释放；滑动停止后，两边仍可有永久错位，也可能仍有未释放的作用。另一些断层可以缓慢滑动，并不是每次板块移动都会发生地震。

en.sourceText: In this kind of sudden slip after locking, resistance can decrease once sliding starts, allowing slip to develop rapidly. Elastic deformation decreases and some stored energy is released. After motion stops, permanent offset and some remaining loading can persist. Other faults can creep slowly; not every movement of a plate produces an earthquake.

scenes.zh: 波经过时，一处岩石的运动与变形影响相邻的岩石，变化接着传下去。单个小标记只在附近运动，能量却能传得更远。真实地震波有不同种类，地面可以向不同方向振动；图中选一个方向慢看，圆圈记录变化到达哪里，不是石头或能量的外壳。
scenes.en: As a wave passes, motion and deformation at one place affect neighboring rock, carrying the disturbance onward. One marker moves locally, while energy can travel farther. Real seismic waves have different kinds of motion. This view slows one direction for observation; its circle marks where the disturbance has arrived, not a shell of rock or energy.

zh.sourceText: 波经过时，一处岩石的运动与变形影响相邻的岩石，变化接着传下去。单个小标记只在附近运动，能量却能传得更远。真实地震波有不同种类，地面可以向不同方向振动；图中选一个方向慢看，圆圈记录变化到达哪里，不是石头或能量的外壳。

en.sourceText: As a wave passes, motion and deformation at one place affect neighboring rock, carrying the disturbance onward. One marker moves locally, while energy can travel farther. Real seismic waves have different kinds of motion. This view slows one direction for observation; its circle marks where the disturbance has arrived, not a shell of rock or energy.

interactions.zh: 接缝还没滑，周围岩石发生了什么？
interactions.en: What changes in the rock while the fault is still stuck?

interactions.zh: 从原来的纹路开始看：先让外面的作用继续。
interactions.en: Start with the original markings. Let loading continue.

interactions.zh: 接缝锁住，周围岩石形变并储能。灰色虚线留下了原来的纹路。
interactions.en: The fault is locked. Surrounding rock deforms and stores energy. Gray dashed lines show the original markings.

interactions.zh: 阻力被克服，断层开始滑动，周围岩石部分回弹。
interactions.en: Resistance is overcome. The fault slips and surrounding rock rebounds partly.

interactions.zh: 变形减小了，纹路却仍错开：回弹与永久错位可以同时留下。
interactions.en: Deformation decreased, but the markings remain offset: rebound can leave permanent fault offset.

interactions.zh: 看振动传开，也看小标记留在哪里。
interactions.en: Watch the disturbance spread, and see where each marker stays.

interactions.zh: 地下与地表标记都在原位；同一次振动将依次到达。
interactions.en: Both markers are at their starting places. One disturbance will reach them in turn.

interactions.zh: 振动经过地下标记：标记在附近来回动，变化继续传向地表。
interactions.en: The disturbance passes the underground marker. It moves locally as the disturbance continues toward the surface.

interactions.zh: 振动到达地表，地表标记也来回动起来；地下标记没有跑上来。
interactions.en: The disturbance reaches the surface marker and it moves locally too. The underground marker did not travel up here.

interactions.zh: 脉冲已经过这两个标记，它们回到原位附近；到达记录留下了传播的先后。
interactions.en: The pulse has passed both markers. They are near their starting places; arrival records show the sequence of propagation.

interactions.zh: 灰色圈是原位，彩色点是现在：放大看往返，不随波跑走。
interactions.en: The gray ring is the starting place; the colored point is its current position. Enlarge the back-and-forth motion without following the wave.

interactions.zh: 持续作用 → 形变储能 → 断层滑动与部分回弹 → 地震波传播 → 地面振动。
interactions.en: Continued loading → elastic deformation and stored energy → fault slip and partial rebound → seismic waves → ground motion.

why.zh: 大地为什么一直受着作用？
为什么会突然滑，而不是慢慢滑？
石头没跑远，振动怎么传过去？
why.en: How does vibration travel without the rock traveling?

adultNotes.zh: 本书讲断层锁定后突然滑动的一种机制。采用向内挤压的逆断层弹簧摩擦模型；时间与变形被放大，图中弯曲不能当现实岩石的肉眼变化或地震倒计时。外部加载在本次滑移后停止，便于单次观察；现实构造作用并不因此停止。波是均匀介质中的单一纵向脉冲，忽略多波型、衰减、场地效应与复杂破裂；放大窗口只放大局部位移，圆线是传播到达示意。断层永久位移和波的局部振动不同，真实地点还可能有永久变形。旗子只记到达，不能判断强弱或安全。本书不提供预测或避险指导。
adultNotes.en: This book follows one mechanism: sudden slip after local fault locking. A compression-driven reverse-fault spring/friction model scales time and deformation for observation; bending is not a visible real-rock precursor or an earthquake countdown. Loading stops after this one slip for observation; real tectonic loading does not stop then. The wave is one longitudinal pulse in a uniform medium, omitting multiple wave types, attenuation, site effects, and complex rupture. The enlarged window magnifies local displacement only, and the circle marks propagation arrival. Fault offset differs from local wave motion; real locations can also undergo permanent deformation. Flags record arrival, not strength or safety. This is not a forecast or an emergency guide.
